method: fresh interpreter per sample; alternating load/iterload order; same deterministic ASCII arrays; source reading, SHA256 and complete field aggregation inside timing; GC enabled; fixture creation and source receipts outside timing; optional tracing in separate workers
limitations: synthetic event records on one host; OS file cache is uncontrolled; RSS includes interpreter and backend imports; first-item source bytes measure the raw source API, not physical disk traffic; timing includes aggregation and hashing and is not an isolated decoder throughput claim; memory depends on the largest individual item and configured chunk size

publication_normalization.note: Consumer labels, artifact paths and machine-specific origins normalized for public publication. Historical timings, measured payload bytes and original source digests retain their captured meaning; normalized source/archive bytes have their own publication hashes.
